description: Human `prose run` names `prose cli run submit FILE` and suggests its help; nothing reaches the harness.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: That command isn't quite right.
Detail: `run` alone runs nothing here: hosted runs are `prose cli run submit FILE`; did you mean `prose cli run submit --help`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: Use `cli run submit`: `prose cli run submit --help`.
